article.title_es: National Council of Jewish Women: despensa y comidas en Manhattan
article.title_en: National Council of Jewish Women: pantry and meals in Manhattan
article.summary_es: National Council of Jewish Women aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos y cocina de sopa en el Upper West Side de Manhattan. Ofrece despensa los lunes y comidas los miércoles y domingos.
article.summary_en: National Council of Jewish Women appears on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry and soup kitchen on Manhattan's Upper West Side. It offers pantry service on Mondays and meals on Wednesdays and Sundays.
how_they_help_es: Despensa de alimentos los lunes de 9:30am a 1:30pm.
Cocina de sopa los miércoles de 4:30pm a 5pm.
Cocina de sopa los domingos de 11:30am a 12:30pm.
Qué alimentos entrega y si hay requisitos no están indicados; pregunte por teléfono.
how_they_help_en: Food pantry on Mondays from 9:30am to 1:30pm.
Soup kitchen on Wednesdays from 4:30pm to 5pm.
Soup kitchen on Sundays from 11:30am to 12:30pm.
What food is given and any requirements are not listed; ask by phone.
visit_tips_es: Llame al (212) 799-7205 antes de ir para confirmar los horarios.
Los horarios de despensa y de cocina de sopa son distintos; planifique su visita según el día.
La dirección es 241 W 72nd St, New York, NY 10023.
visit_tips_en: Call (212) 799-7205 before going to confirm the hours.
Pantry and soup kitchen hours are different; plan your visit by day.
The address is 241 W 72nd St, New York, NY 10023.

faq_es.a: Según el mapa Food Help NYC, es una despensa de alimentos y una cocina de sopa.
Despensa: lunes 9:30am-1:30pm. Cocina de sopa: miércoles 4:30pm-5pm y domingo 11:30am-12:30pm.
El teléfono indicado es (212) 799-7205. Llame para confirmar detalles antes de ir.

faq_en.a: According to the Food Help NYC map, it is a food pantry and a soup kitchen.
Pantry: Monday 9:30am-1:30pm. Soup kitchen: Wednesday 4:30pm-5pm and Sunday 11:30am-12:30pm.
The listed phone number is (212) 799-7205. Call to confirm details before going.
